content.title: THE FORGE GAP
content.observation: There is NO generic loader/activator for hand-authored authority fixtures. The only consumer of mind-universe-authority-fixture files is hardcoded to behavior-bond-authority.json in universe-testkit (create_/open_behavior_bond_authority_store, validate_fixture_patch asserts BEHAVIOR_BOND_AUTHORITY_KEYS).
content.consequence: Every hand-authored loop - including this vision-integration loop AND the repeat-until-limit loop - is structurally valid but NOT runtime-activatable, so its Health is not_measured.
content.meta_prerequisite: A generic authority-fixture activator (install -> intern symbols -> activate ChangeSet -> independent readback via OntologyRegistry::load) must be built first, itself graph-derived.

content.title: THE MEASURED-ENERGY MEMBRANE BLOCKER
content.observation: canonical_ride produces only derived / not_measured energy, and universe-protocol refuses to stream non-Measured energy across the membrane.
content.consequence: The felt glide cannot cross to the renderer.
content.required_fix: A real calibration/measurement path that produces Measured energy - NOT a file-side bypass of the membrane.

content.title: PRIORITIZATION (Angry-Birds lesson from ideas.md)
content.observation: One polished gesture (the glide) beats ten half-built magic objects.
content.implication: The substrate largely EXISTS; the named verbs/operators are what is new. Focus effort on making one operator fully felt and measured before proliferating.

content.title: SUBSTRATE-VS-VERBS
content.observation: Already existing substrate: spring joints, damping, energy ledger + conservation, support/inhibit/neutral polarity, BehaviorBond + gates, epistemic opcodes, TopologicalFold lifecycle.
content.new_work: The operators as first-class primitives are mostly new.
content.leverage: A single ForceLaw enum variant would unlock Gap Gravity Grenade + Aegis Shield + Tombstone Anchor together.

content.title: DIEGETIC-LAYER-IS-A-HUMAN-AFFORDANCE
content.decision: The 3D/physical 'skin' need not be causal; it is a legibility/accessibility layer FOR HUMANS. An AI can disable it - AIs operate on the raw graph, not the castle.
content.implication: Cosmetic is not cheating: it is a translation layer for a mind that needs space and gravity to understand.

content.title: COST-IS-ENERGY
content.observation: Tool/traversal cost can be denominated in the EXISTING conserved AtomEnergyLedger (invariant: initial+injected == stored, universe-physics). 'Cost = distance travelled by the Board' is not a metaphor: it is energy spent to traverse.
content.note: The currency already exists (observed); only billing traversal against it remains (planned / not_measured).

content.title: FUN-IS-THE-PRODUCT / EMERGENT-PLAY-IS-VALUE
content.decision: Emergent creation is first-class value ('Minecraft for cognition'): if users open boost-potion shops, build castles, or repaint the Mona Lisa in a loop, that IS the win.
content.constraint: Do NOT over-apply causal purity. Strict physical causality is REQUIRED ONLY at the safety trio (Hysteresis / Tombstone / Prism, which protect the mind); the creative/economic layer may be beautiful and emergent.

content.title: THREE-LAYERS-NOT-TWO
content.decision: Distinguish three layers, not two: (1) Truth - must be real/measured/honest (epistemic states, energy ledger); (2) Legibility - must be FAITHFUL, not causal (seeing the graph); (3) Diegetic play - fun, emergent, disable-able.
content.correction: The earlier 'causal vs cosmetic' tension was a false dichotomy that conflated Legibility (load-bearing) with Play (optional).

content.title: LEGIBILITY-IS-THE-PRESENT-UNLOCK
content.observation: The core present value of the viz is NOT physics-causality but making the invisible graph VISIBLE. Epistemic states rendered in space (measured / unknown / known_absent / measurement_failed), seen live in the running viz today, give trust unattainable from reading JSONL.
content.human_statement: I have never been able to see what was in this graph, and that changes everything.
content.framing: Legibility of the graph - not the physics being causal - is what 'changes everything' right now. Physics-causality is the later unlock; legibility is the present one.
